title: Grade badge uses aria-label on a bare span (prohibited, name may be dropped) [4.1.2 Name, Role, Value]
steps: Open any page showing a grade, run axe aria-prohibited-attr (needs-review)
expected: Badge text is exposed as "Grade B" reliably (visible text prefixed with sr-only "Grade", or role="img" with aria-label).
actual: B has no role; axe flags aria-prohibited-attr (incomplete) on landing (5), results (20), game pages, slate. Many screen readers ignore the label and read just "B". The black-on-amber contrast itself is fine (11.46:1).
evidence: axe incomplete: aria-prohibited-attr, "aria-label attribute is not well supported on a span with no valid role attribute"
